title: Office — which editors to build on, after the Euro-Office test

steps.path: The editors inside the Office download
steps.headline: After the test, which editors should Office be built on?
steps.today: You asked to test Euro-Office first. Your six files came back from Euro-Office's and OnlyOffice's file translators identically, with nothing lost in either.
steps.problem: The difference is not quality: OnlyOffice requires its logo inside the editor and is a large, current team; Euro-Office drops the logo rule but is smaller, one version behind, and OnlyOffice disputes its right to drop it.
steps.proposal: Pick the base. Both use the same settings and add-on system, so switching later means a re-test, not a rebuild.

options.label: Euro-Office
pros: No outside logo: the editor can look fully like YouCoded.
An offline Euro-Office app built the way ours would be already exists to learn from.
Backed by Nextcloud, IONOS and other European companies.
cons: About a dozen active people, versus OnlyOffice's much larger team.
One version behind; new OnlyOffice features may arrive months later, or not at all.
OnlyOffice says the logo removal breaks its licence; the licence's own stewards disagree. Worth the lawyer check before launch.

options.label: OnlyOffice
pros: The newest version, from the team that wrote nearly all of the code.
No licence dispute hanging over it.
cons: A small OnlyOffice logo must stay visible in every open document.
The company has been hostile to projects that change its branding.
